title: The sandbox-start benchmark trio is split: harness and summary in ticks, raw artifact and container here
body: e08 moved only the raw dated artifact because that is all its guard reads, so re-measurement (scripts/bench_sandbox_start.py) still lives in ticks and would measure ticks' sandbox copy, not the one the factory embeds. Decide where re-measurement belongs now that the container ships from ticfac, and move or repoint the harness and docs/sandbox-start-benchmark.md accordingly.
